task: Fix the Datadog metrics client after Datadog deprecated the v1 metrics submission endpoint.

candidate_memories.content: Metric submission failures show 410 Gone; Datadog sunset the v1 /api/v1/series endpoint for custom metrics.
Custom metrics must now be submitted to the /api/v2/series endpoint with the updated payload schema.
The v2 payload uses a resources array instead of the host field for metric tagging.
When a monitoring provider removes a metric submission endpoint, update both the URL and payload schema.
Datadog integration note (session 6): submit custom metrics to /api/v1/series with a host field and tags array.
candidate_memories.notes: external_dependency_change: Datadog v1 /api/v1/series endpoint sunsetted; v2 /api/v2/series is required

candidate_memories.content: Old monitoring note says the Datadog v1 API is reliable and used by most legacy integrations.
